title: AI code review model response
description: The only shape the model may return. Enforced by review_agent/parser.py. A response failing this schema triggers exactly one stricter retry (FR-022); a second failure ends the run as a degraded review (FR-029), never as partial or invented feedback. Note that false coverage claims are NOT part of this contract - they are derived from `coverage` plus the PR description's declared scope by the agent, so the headline finding is a deterministic function of the coverage map.

coverage.description: One entry per acceptance criterion of every linked story. Empty array when no work item is linked (FR-008).

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion, quoted or closely paraphrased from the story.

status.description: appears_addressed: the diff plausibly implements it. not_addressed: no related changes - NEUTRAL, never a defect, never comments, never fails the run (FR-016). possible_contradiction: the diff conflicts with it - the only loud flag.

evidence.description: What in the diff supports this status. For not_addressed, a brief statement that nothing related was found. Must reference the diff, not speculate about code not shown.

checklist_violations.description: Only real violations of the combined checklist. An empty array is the correct answer for a clean diff - do not invent stylistic filler (FR-019).

item.description: The checklist item that is violated, as written in the checklist.

source.description: Filename of the checklist this item came from, exactly as labelled in the combined checklist (FR-019).

issue.description: How this diff violates that item.

file.description: Repo-relative path from the diff, or omitted / empty when the violation is not file-specific.

line.description: Line in the post-change file. 0 or omitted means no specific line - the finding then routes to the summary discussion instead of an inline comment (FR-025).

code_issues.description: Defects visible in the diff text. Not style preferences, and not anything requiring the code to be run.

severity.description: high: incorrect behaviour, data loss, or a security problem. medium: a real defect with limited blast radius. low: worth knowing, not worth blocking. Only `high` participates in the blocking exit code (FR-028).

file.description: Repo-relative path from the diff, or omitted when not file-specific.

line.description: Line in the post-change file. 0 or omitted routes the finding to the summary (FR-025).

summary.description: Plain-language overall summary for the reviewer (FR-021). Reports what the change does and what is worth a human's attention. Never asserts that unaddressed criteria are defects.
